titleText: 69-year-old man grievously injured in Birkirkara traffic accident
mainText: From The Malta Independent: 69-year-old man grievously injured in Birkirkara traffic accident. A 69-year-old man from l-Iklin was seriously injured in a traffic accident in Triq Dun Karm, Birkirkara, on Monday morning. The accident happened at around 5am and involved three cars, the police said.

titleText: How well did Shakespeare know the Classics?
mainText: From Times of Malta: How well did Shakespeare know the Classics? A lecture at the National Library on November 25 will debate Shakespeare’s relationship with Greek and Roman literature, examining how classical influence shaped his works
